newsitem.title: USA: TCI Satellite completes financing arrangement.
newsitem.headline: TCI Satellite completes financing arrangement.

text.p: TCI Satellite Entertainment Inc said Friday it had completed a senior secured bank financing arrangement underwritten by The Bank of Nova Scotia, Credit Lyonnais, and NationsBank Corp.

The company, a digital satellite concern that was recently spun off from Tele-Communications Inc, said it was able to borrow up to $350 million under the facility with commitments increasing to $750 million.
It said it planned to use the money to repay $250 million of debt to Tele-Communications and fund the growth of its medium- and high-power satellite business.
